TRAFFIC ADVISORY

Special traffic arrangements will be in place for the LIVE MUSIC CONCERT “P-POP CULTURE INDIA TOUR 2026” featuring Punjabi Pop Singer Karan Aujla at Jawahar Lal Nehru Stadium, Lodhi Colony, New Delhi on 28.02.2026 (Saturday).

A gathering of approx. 45,000–50,000 spectators is expected. Traffic restrictions/diversions will be implemented around the stadium for smooth conduct and public safety.

Time: 04:00 PM – 10:00 PM

📍 STADIUM ENTRY GATES
-Gates 2, 6, 8, 13, 14 & 21 – For Spectators
-Gate 13 – VIP Entry
-Gate 6 – Artist/Organisers Entry
-Gates 1 & 10 – Reserved for Emergency

📍 LIKELY AFFECTED ROADS / DIVERSION POINTS
-JLN Red Light
-Sewa Nagar Bus Depot Red Light
-5th Avenue Road (Double Story Market/Dhobi Ghat)
-Pragati Vihar Red Light
-Lala Lajpat Rai Marg T-Point
-Barapullah Cut near JLN Gate No. 5
-Jangpura Metro Station / Suchna Bhawan T-Point

📍PUBLIC ADVISORY
-Avoid B.P. Marg, Lodhi Road & roads around JLN Stadium during peak hours.
-Commuters heading to Airport, Railway Stations & Hospitals are advised to plan in advance.
-Spectators are encouraged to use Metro services (JLN Stadium Metro Station – Violet Line).

📍Stay updated through Delhi Traffic Police social media channels.

#DPTrafficAdvisory
